about: Point 1-4 (id fortress; Henry, Nov 23-24; modern military theme): four teams attack each other's bases. Created with LM2, a student. Questions come from Quiz Dash's bank, Battle of Wits sets or a unit; this file only holds the How to play slides.

intro.title: Point 1-4
text: One HQ and four buildings: defend your base, attack the others.
Answer questions to win weapons, repairs and gold!

rows: 2,400 HP: lose it and you are out

intro.title: Weapons
text: Right answer: choose a weapon, a repair or gold.

intro.title: The store
text: After every team has had a turn: Haishi Trade Company opens.
Then fire your weapons at any enemy base!

rows: keep it: fixes or rebuilds a building

intro.title: Defend your base
text: HQ destroyed? Use a repair kit or sacrifice a building!

rows: one tower gone = half the chance
kit or sacrifice, or you are out

intro.title: Power-ups
text: One of each per team, once per game.
Question Change: swap for a Hard or Impossible question!

intro.title: Made with LM2
text: a student who helped design the game. Thank you, LM2!

rows: last base, or the strongest after the rounds
